en: Color postcard showing a bright spring or summer rural landscape: a wide meadow full of yellow flowers, paths crossing the grass, a small pale-colored house with a red tiled roof on a gentle hill, dense green trees behind it, and a light-colored coach or bus parked near the house. In the foreground two people walk along a path toward the bus. The sky is blue with light clouds. A small printed caption appears in the bottom‑right corner.
